extraction.Name: Jennie Moeller
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want it, as she did not desire to pay taxes, but that the Indian Agency informed her that she would have to take it, so she accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged her allotment to G.H.Cherry, of Martin, South Dakota, for $600.00, to pay taxes and get farm machinery; that, on July 15, 1924, she not having paid back any of this $600.00, Mr.Cherry canceled this mortgage in favor of a second mortgage, or contract, for $1000.00, which was to be paid by July 12, 1925; and that she never has paid Mr.Cherry anything on this contract, nor has she had any legal notice that it has been foreclosed
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to G.H. Cherry of Martin, South Dakota for $600.00; second mortgage/contract for $1000.00 to same
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: mortgaged her allotment to G.H.Cherry, of Martin, South Dakota, for $600.00, to pay taxes and get farm machinery
extraction.Occupation/Income: self-supporting, by working for other people in homes
extraction.NOTES: Allotment covers the SEL, Sec. 29, T. 37 N. R. 36 W. 6th P.M., in South Dakota; mentally competent; health is good; has five minor children to support on her own efforts, being separated from her husband, who is supposed to contribute $10.00 per month for the support of his children, but has failed to do so; does not help to support any relatives; has never received any help from the County or the Government; document reference number 24491; subscribed and sworn November 16, 1928, Shannon County, State of South Dakota
